[intro briefing]: Learn indirect control: scout with a flag, supply your colony, and direct an attack.
[intro instruction scout]: Open Flags and place an Exploration Flag over the stone patch east of your colony. Assign one explorer. Watch it travel to the flag.
[intro help supply]: Construction and everyday supply have separate worker targets. Select the finished Inn and increase its operating target. A supplier gathers wheat and carries it here. Hungry globules eat at Inns; a building with no suppliers will eventually run out. Keep the wheat patch accessible.
[intro help touch attack]: Open Flags, choose War Flag, place it over the enemy Swarm east of the stone and confirm. Select the flag and request up to 4 warriors. A small radius concentrates them. If none remain, produce warriors at your Swarm. Warriors may stop to eat; keep the Inns supplied.
[lesson healing briefing]: Build a Hospital and help a wounded worker recover. The colony starts fed, with one injured worker.
[lesson defensive-tactics guard help]: Open Flags, choose Guard and paint at least 4 tiles inside the area. Guard zones attract idle warriors. Forbidden zones block travel; clearing zones request resource removal.
[stat worker time about]: What the colony's workers were doing, moment by moment: working for a building, working at a flag, training, eating, healing, waiting hungry or hurt with no inn or hospital free, or idle with nothing to do. A healthy colony keeps most of its workers working, few idle and none waiting.
[stat warrior level about]: The average attack level of the colony's warriors, counting attack speed and attack strength equally, on the 1 to 4 scale the game shows. Barracks raise it; new untrained warriors pull it down.
[settings Press a key. Escape cancels ca: Press a key. Escape cancels capture. Use Bind Escape to assign Escape.
[Portage Lakes cannot fit a useful dry w: Portage Lakes cannot fit a useful dry woodland shortcut on this seed.
[lesson upgrades upgrade hint]: Select the Racetrack, choose Upgrade and assign skilled builders. These workers already learned first-level School skills. Upgrades need extra space and materials, and interrupt the building service. Cancelled upgrades do not count.
